components.css: @property --c{syntax:'<color>';inherits:false;initial-value:#6f6a5d}@property --s{syntax:'<length>';inherits:false;initial-value:16px}.ds-cell{display:grid;gap:6px;width:150px}.ds-tile{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:#242220;display:block;cursor:pointer}.ds-tile::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;--c:#6f6a5d;--s:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--c) 50%,transparent 50%) top left/var(--s) var(--s) no-repeat,linear-gradient(225deg,var(--c) 50%,transparent 50%) top right/var(--s) var(--s) no-repeat,linear-gradient(45deg,var(--c) 50%,transparent 50%) bottom left/var(--s) var(--s) no-repeat,linear-gradient(315deg,var(--c) 50%,transparent 50%) bottom right/var(--s) var(--s) no-repeat;transition:--c .2s,--s .2s}.ds-tile:hover::after,.ds-tile:focus-visible::after{--c:#d8a23c;--s:22px}.ds-caption{font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#b3ac9c;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 8px}

narrative.overview: PhotoVault is the album the group keeps together, not a file manager. Deep bottle-green album cloth surrounds black card pages; each print is seated in four photo corners and captioned in small white ink. Dark only. Frame numbers were dropped (they shift as uploads arrive); the viewer stays dark and closes on Escape.
keyCharacteristics: Committed shell: green cloth around black pages.
Signature move: photo corners, gold on hover/focus.
One gold, only on pressable or in-progress things.
Whole-cell grid that repacks at any width.

rules.name: The Gold-Means-Press Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on pressable controls, focus, selection and in-progress state. Never decorative.

rules.name: The Photos-Glow Rule
rules.body: Page black stays neutral and warm-grey so no UI color competes with photo color.

rules.name: The Tabular-Ink Rule
rules.body: Dates, durations and progress percentages use tabular numerals so changing values do not jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone and 1px hairline, never by shadow.

dos: Do let corner mounts and the date caption be the only world detail on a cell.
Do reserve gold for press, focus, selection and progress.
Do keep upload progress, failure and retry unambiguous in the drop strip.
Do keep the viewer dark and closable by Escape.
Do separate surfaces by tone and hairline, not shadow.
donts: Don't let it read as a cloud-storage tool: no file-list rows, folder trees or storage meters.
Don't add social-feed devices: likes, reactions, engagement counts.
Don't let decoration compete with the photographs.
Don't reintroduce frame numbers; they shift as uploads arrive.
